requests.prompt: Realistic full body photo of ONE person for a game character 3D model, front view only, camera at chest height straight on, plain light grey background. The look of a modern open world game like Watch Dogs 2: grounded, real proportions, natural skin and cloth, photoreal, no cartoon. Pose: a strict T-pose: both arms stretched straight out to the sides at shoulder height, palms facing down, fingers slightly apart, a clear gap between the arms and the body, legs slightly apart with a gap between the knees, feet flat. Clothes hang naturally and do not stick to the body: a visible gap of air under the arms and between the jacket or shirt and the arms. Whole body visible from head to feet with space around it, even soft studio light, no shadow on the background, no text, no logo, only one person in the image. The person: an Indian man from Delhi, age 28, auto-rickshaw driver, young but sun-worn, lean wiry build, 1.72 m, realistic proportions about 7.5 heads tall. Face: warm brown skin tanned darker on the forehead and cheeks, laugh lines at the eyes, mouth closed with a faint amused smile, slightly tired eyes, thin neat moustache and two days of stubble, even skin, short black hair messy from the wind. Clothes: a loose faded khaki uniform shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbows, top button open, worn untucked, dark grey cotton trousers, worn rubber sandals, a red and white checked cotton gamchha towel over his left shoulder hanging down his chest, an old plain steel wristwatch on his left wrist.

review.note: Approved 2026-11-14 (T-pose front): clean T-pose, clear gaps under the arms and between the legs, closed-mouth faint smile, gamchha, steel watch, rolled sleeves. Ready for image to 3D.
